question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ensured**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**ensured**" means to make certain or guarantee something. (सुरक्षित पखना)
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of verifying or guaranteeing something.
 
 
• **Example**: *The security measures in the airport ensured the safety of all passengers.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Verified **means to confirm or make sure of something. (जांच करना)
 
• **Constrained **means to restrict or limit something. (विवश किया हुआ)
 
• **Confirmed **means to establish the truth or correctness of something. (पक्का किया हुआ)
